Where they win

Whisper Notes is cheaper: $7.99 on 2026-10-24, against $29 for Distavo, and it has hundreds of ratings where Distavo has none yet. Humla and Meetily are free and open source. MacWhisper is the best-known name in the category and has a free tier. Distavo asks for more setup, because summaries need an Ollama server, Apple Intelligence or the opt-in on-device model.

Where Distavo fits

Choose Distavo if you work in Catalan or Spanish, want transcripts and summaries to stay on your Mac or your own server, and want a Markdown note per meeting with decisions and actions. See the five-minute setup.
